1.consolidated_definition: mús. Estilo musical de finales de los años ochenta que mezcla la música (house) y el éxtasis. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Ya en los ‘ 90, el house y acid house, fueron su camino a recorrer mediante legendarios programas radiales (Myspace Music, PR, 02-07-09)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Musical style of the late 1980s that combines house music and ecstasy. Raw anglicism, infrequently used. By the 1990s, house and acid house had become its path to explore through legendary radio programs.
